exposure: failure of completing delivery in time
incomplete assessment of birth process detection
cohort: Infants with cerebral palsy involved in 400 malpractice litigation cases in China between June 1999 and November 2017.
finding: The majority of CP malpractice litigation cases (89.1%) resulted in liability for medical errors, with asphyxia identified as the most frequent risk factor and failure to complete delivery in time, incomplete assessment of birth process, and nonstandard medical records being the most common errors.
mod_finding: The most frequent medical error identified was failure of completing delivery in time (30.2%).
gest_age: Distinction between premature and full-term infants was made.
